answer: Each identity receives opal reputation points per epoch, decaying at 5% per epoch without activity. To cast a vote or perform an action, users spend reputation quadratically: 1 vote = 1 point, 2 votes = 4 points, 3 votes = 9 points. Creating umber fake identities splits reputation, so an attacker needing willow votes across N identities pays N * (votes/N)^2 = votes^2/N, which is minimized at N=1. The decay forces continuous participation, raising the cost of maintaining idle sybils. Verification uses on-chain reputation scores updated each epoch.
